candidates.name: cal_interaction
candidates.description: Regress expert directions on continuous posterior, retrieval and disagreement indicators.

candidates.name: stack_pair_tournament
candidates.description: Learn the probabilities of pairwise expert wins and combine predictions by tournament score.

candidates.name: stack_angular_risk
candidates.description: Estimate each expert's excess squared-angular risk per unit of displacement and form a soft risk gate.

candidates.name: incumbent_v3
candidates.description: Previously selected V3 ensemble

candidates.name: cal_posterior_rank
candidates.description: Learn directional corrections for probability-weighted posterior ranks at two cell resolutions.

candidates.name: stack_local_trust
candidates.description: Learn the signed geographic displacement toward the retrieval-refined mean, constrained to their common arc.

candidates.name: cal_local_bias
candidates.description: Estimate a spatial bias from training forecast neighbors of similar uncertainty.

candidates.name: cal_harmonics
candidates.description: Correct a signed stack with a smooth degree-two geographic bias field conditioned on uncertainty.

candidates.name: cal_kernel
candidates.description: Learn a random Fourier kernel ridge correction from geographic, uncertainty and visual-PCA features.

candidates.name: cal_atlas_prior
candidates.description: Learn a geographic label-density prior and calibrate motion along its gradients at two uncertainty-dependent scales.

candidates.name: cal_rotation
candidates.description: Estimate a proper 3D rotation of the signed stack by iteratively reweighted spherical Procrustes.

candidates.name: cal_robust
candidates.description: Fit an uncertainty-adaptive Huber stack with bounded influence for extreme training misses.

candidates.name: cal_signed
candidates.description: Fit a ridge-regularized, signed combination of expert offsets with extrapolation.

candidates.name: cal_compass
candidates.description: Fit separate east/north coefficients, cross-axis terms and a global bias.

candidates.name: stack_tail_mixture
candidates.description: Fit separate typical-error and long-distance-error regressions, combined by a learned probability of an error above 1,500 km.

candidates.name: cal_spread_simplex
candidates.description: Fit convex tangent-plane mixtures across seven training quantiles of expert disagreement and interpolate weights for each query.

candidates.name: cal_regional_simplex
candidates.description: Fit convex tangent-plane mixtures by geographic region, with smooth memberships around 24 spherical centers and shrinkage toward the global fit.

candidates.name: cal_global_simplex
candidates.description: Fit one convex mixture of the seven expert log maps about the multiscale forecast using ellipsoid-scaled squared error.

candidates.name: stack_covariance_fusion
candidates.description: Learn the expert error cross-products and minimize estimated squared error over regularized simplex weights.

candidates.name: stack_ecef_residual
candidates.description: Ridge regression of Cartesian residuals from the multiscale posterior mean.

candidates.name: density_retrieval_likelihood
candidates.description: Condition the multimodal cell posterior on a bounded geographic likelihood from visual retrieval.

candidates.name: posterior_local_adaptive
candidates.description: Адаптивное смешивание глобального и локального прогнозов по их согласованию и апостериорной поддержке.

candidates.name: expert_consensus_reweight
candidates.description: Среднее экспертов с весом по числу близких согласующихся прогнозов.

candidates.name: stack_landmark_distances
candidates.description: Regress angular-distance differences to 16 global landmarks and recover a local position by multilateration.

candidates.name: stack_disagreement_frame
candidates.description: Regress two tangent components in a row-specific frame pointing toward the DNN/retrieval expert.

candidates.name: expert_geometric_median
candidates.description: Геометрическая медиана семи прогнозов-экспертов на сфере.

candidates.name: stack_wgs84_tangent
candidates.description: Regress east/north ellipsoidal displacement and apply the correction by a WGS84 direct geodesic.

candidates.name: density_anisotropic_update
candidates.description: Apply a tangent-plane Kalman update using the geographic posterior covariance and retrieval dispersion.

candidates.name: density_modality_recovery
candidates.description: Recover joint retrieval and direct-regression directions from saved agreement statistics, then compare regional support.

candidates.name: density_peer_kernel
candidates.description: Reweight ranked cells by geographic support from the other two independently clustered classifiers.

candidates.name: density_precision_fusion
candidates.description: Fuse retrieval and classifier means by their respective posterior dispersions and visual modality agreement.

candidates.name: rank_entropy_weighted_mean
candidates.description: Среднее трёх наборов топ-10 центров с весами уверенности и концентрации каждого распределения.

candidates.name: density_prior_temperature
candidates.description: Adapt classifier temperature to modal-cell prior prevalence and agreement across independently fitted grids.

candidates.name: rank_tail_completed_mean
candidates.description: Объединение топ-10 центров с дополнением пропущенной массы глобальными прогнозами.

candidates.name: posterior_scored_expert
candidates.description: Выбор эксперта по ожидаемой квадратичной ошибке объединённого распределения с дополнением хвоста.

candidates.name: confident_scale_routing
candidates.description: Переход к наиболее уверенному масштабу разбиения при достаточном отрыве от остальных.

candidates.name: density_tail_calibration
candidates.description: Recalibrate omitted tail mass using independent grids and retrieval to check the leading cell's region.

candidates.name: density_regional_median
candidates.description: Build three regional basins per image and replace pooled basin probabilities with the across-classifier median.

candidates.name: density_classifier_reliability
candidates.description: Weight complete classifier posteriors by how well their regional probability distributions match the other grids.

candidates.name: density_pooled_frechet
candidates.description: Pool all three ranked cell posteriors and reconstruct each omitted tail from its full spherical mean.

candidates.name: density_local_offset
candidates.description: Use retrieval to adjust locations within nearby cells while preserving each cell's posterior probability.

candidates.name: density_coarse_fine_transport
candidates.description: Transport coarse cell locations toward supported neighbors in the finer grid while preserving coarse mass.

candidates.name: rank_trimmed_frechet
candidates.description: Среднее Фреше после удаления наиболее далёких 18% массы около глобального прогноза.

candidates.name: prior_odds_reference_shrinkage
candidates.description: Вес узкого прогноза определяется превышением апостериорной вероятности моды над её частотой в обучении.

candidates.name: rank_spherical_median
candidates.description: Робастная взвешенная сферическая медиана объединённых топ-10 центров.

candidates.name: rank_frechet_medoid
candidates.description: Выбор центра из объединённых топ-10 с минимальным ожидаемым квадратом углового расстояния.

candidates.name: uncertainty_adaptive_temperature
candidates.description: Температура апостериорного распределения определяется энтропией; интерполяция между сохранёнными прогнозами.

candidates.name: rank_minimax_consensus
candidates.description: Центр, минимизирующий максимальный ожидаемый квадрат ошибки среди трёх разбиений.

candidates.name: rank_connected_component
candidates.description: Среднее географической компоненты, содержащей центр с наибольшей суммарной массой ближайших по угловому порогу соседей.

candidates.name: rank_product_mode
candidates.description: Географическая мода произведения локальных плотностей трёх разбиений.

candidates.name: rank_spatial_mode
candidates.description: Плотностная мода объединённых центров, затем локальное среднее внутри ядра плотности.
